latest_substantive_result.summary: A specified delayed division-noise countermodel can match one aggregate growth statistic and yields additional testable predictions, including suppressed short-lag across-division variation and a late-cycle averaged-growth variance upturn. The latter is qualitatively in tension with inspected published curves, but without raw-data replay this is not a formal rejection. No new natural law, molecular mechanism or historic-scale discovery was established.
